name: @openmatter-network/matter-sdk-core
description: MatterSDK core, with zero runtime dependencies: seal secrets under the matter-kgc committee and recover them via a signed, threshold partial-decrypt quorum.
author: Open Matter <admin@openmatter.network>

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../../bindings/wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/typescript-core/wasm --out-name matter_sdk_wasm && rm -f ../../packages/typescript-core/wasm/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm-web: cd ../../bindings/wasm && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../../packages/typescript-core/wasm-web --out-name matter_sdk_wasm && rm -f ../../packages/typescript-core/wasm-web/.gitignore
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm-web && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Publish the CI-built, checked tarball (npm publish <file>.tgz), never this directory; see RELEASING.md.' >&2 && exit 1
